reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent agent memory management through a self-hosted mem0 REST service, including memory creation, semantic search, retrieval, updates, history, deletion, and reset operations.

summaries.zh: 通过自托管的 mem0 REST 服务为 DeepSeek Harness Agent 提供记忆写入、语义搜索、读取、更新、历史查询和删除能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with persistent memory operations through a self-hosted mem0 REST service, including writing, semantic search, retrieval, updates, history, and deletion.

capabilities: Reads and writes memories through a configurable mem0 REST service
Supports bulk deletion and full reset with explicit confirmation and admin authorization
Persists service configuration including an API key
